tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin nag po yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi bklag chog tu bkod pa dbang chen thugs kyi yang zhun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rta mgrin nag po yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi bklag chog tu bkod pa dbang chen thugs kyi yang zhun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin nag po yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi bklag chog tu bkod pa dbang chen thugs kyi yang zhun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru badzra kro dhā ya/ nyon mongs mdangs shar sde brgyad ma rungs pa'i// tshang tshing sreg mdzad ye shes chen po'i stobs// bskal me ltar 'bar rdo rje rta yi zhal// lhag pa'i lhar bzung byin rlabs rjes gnang stsol// rta mgrin nag po yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi zab mos slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la/ stegs bur drag dkyil sgo rdzogs lha mtshan sogs mngon rtogs dang mthun yod na bting*/ med na maṇḍal la 'bru tshom dbus su che ba gcig gi mdun dang g.yas g.yon du chung ba gsum/ de rgyab rigs bzhi/ de rgyab sgo bzhi'i grangs mnyam bkod pa'i steng mañdzi la bum pa bcud ldan dar nag mgul chings kha rgyan gzungs rdor bcas bkod/ rgyab ngos dpal gtor rta zhal can padma dang tshe ril gyis bskor zhing dar nag gi gdugs phub pa/ g.yas su thod pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa'i khar me long sindhu ras byugs te gru gsum dbus su hrīḥbris pas bkab/ mdun du rta mgrin rigs lnga gcig bsdus dang rta zhal rigs bdag rnams kyi tsakli/ g.yon du dpal dang dur khrod chas/ sngags byang*/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ ral gri /lcags kyu/ dar nag po rnams dngos sam tsaka li bkod/ sman rag mchod gtor spyi ltar dang*/ las bum/ mig dar me tog /phrin las la mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ dkar gtor dang*/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bcu pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi/ bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsngo ba spyi mthun byas la/ sgrub thabs kyi bka' bsgo nas brtsam mthar chags su btang*/ bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med dkyil 'khor gcig tu gsal btab/ bzlas pa'i skabs dzap khang phyes te bdag mdun gnyis kar spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bcas rtsa sngags ci nus mthar/ nā ga raksha sogs sngags thung btags pa nyer gcig / yaksha kā la sogs sngags tshan dang po btags pa 'ang bdun tsam bzla/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas sogs dang*/

rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer sogs kyis gzungs thag blangs te bum lhar dmigs pa'i rtsa sngags brgya rtsa tsam bzlas nas stong tshigs phul/ bum lha 'od zhu bya/ las bum rtsa sngags la khrus bdun rig pa btags pas byin brlab/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba sogs byas la/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs/ slob ma khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs gtor btang*/ bka' bsgo /mtshams gcod byas la srung 'khor brtan po bsgom/ maṇḍal bkye bsdu/ sems bskyed gsal btab sogs dang khyad par/ de'ang rdo rje'i gsung las/ e ma bdag nyid sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas te: zhi bas 'dul phyir 'jig rten dbang phyug yin: drag pos 'dul phyir rta mgrin nag por bstan: de phyir o rgyan bdag dang gnyis su med: ces 'byung ba ltar sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mchog gi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul du snang ba o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po nyid dpal rta mgrin nag po klu 'dul chen po'i skur bstan nas snang srid kyi dregs pa can thams cad bka' 'og tu bcug /khyad par snyigs dus kyi gza' klu rgyal bsen ma rungs pa rnams drag tu gcun pa'i gdams ngag zab gnad mang du bstan cing mtha' dbus kyi gter gnas rnams su sbas pa las/ snying po'i bcud du gyur pa phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i thugs gter lnga ru bzhugs pa 'dra min gyi rgyas bsdus mang yang don gyi gnad gcig cing*/ de dag gi nang nas kyang gter du sbas pa 'di nyid gzhan las khyad par du zab cing gnyan par gsungs te/ gzhung las/ 'di ni rab tu gnyan cing mthu che bas: sgom bzlas gsal bas sde brgyad khong khrag 'byin: myur tshad rlung 'dra rno tshad spu gri 'dra: me dang rtsi shing skam po 'phrad pa ltar: gdon bgegs bsreg cing 'joms par the tshom med: sprin phung che yang rlung gis gtor ba ltar: kun nas rab tu nad gdon gnod pa sel: nyi ma shar bas mun pa rang sangs ltar: nad gdon sde brgyad gnod pa sel bar byed:

ces bsngags pa'i gdams skor 'di nyid/ lha sras mu rub btsad po'i rnam 'phrul grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gar dbang zhig po gling pas/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i dbu rtse'i snying mdzod ga'u nag po nas gsang ba'i rgya bdun bkrol te skal ldan rnams la snang bar mdzad pa ste/ de lta bu'i smin byed zab mo bsgrub pa la bdag slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub pa lags/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos dang zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i bya ba gnyis su yod pa las thog mar 'jug pa'i rim pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug / bla ma rta mchog drag po dbyer med pa la mi phyed pa'i gus pas snyim pa me tog bcas thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye: dbang chen rol pa dpal gyi dkyil 'khor dgongs: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems: bdag cag dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal: byin rlabs ye shes rlan gyis bskyed du gsol: lan gsum/ kye ho: skal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs: bu khyod dad pas dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug 'dod dam tshig gsum bsrung zhing: dngos grub bsgrub la nan tan 'tshal: mtshams sbyor spyi ltar byas la 'bru gsum gyis mig dar dang me tog sbyin/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed dpal rta mchog drag po'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtshos bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam lha: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum: dpa' bo ḍā ki mkha' 'gro la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: dbang chen rta mgrin bsgrubs nas ni: las bzhis 'gro ba'i don byas nas: sku gsum thob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshogs gsag yan lag bcu pa tshig dang mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal 'debs bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: bla ma rta mgrin lha tshogs gshegs: pad nyi dgra bgegs gdan la bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag ma lus mthol lo bshags: gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs gsol 'debs: snying po sems can don phyir bsngo: yang gsang rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: lan gsum/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig rigs lngas bsdus pa mtha' dag blangs nas bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma dpal chen he ru ka: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sngon tshe rgyal bas thugs bskyed ltar: byang chub sems ni bzung bar bgyi: sangs rgyas rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: rdo rje'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: rin chen rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: padma'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: las kyi rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: gsum brjod/ snying gar bdud rtsi'i thig le bkod la/ khyed rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lngas mtshan par sgoms la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi: lan gsum/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de brtan par byas par mos shig /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ ho:

siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ: sangs rgyas la lus phul bas gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob/ bla ma la lus phul bas rang dbang thob nas gzhan dbang bsgyur/ sems can la lus byin pas gdul bya sbyangs pa can dang 'phrad pa'i dgos pa dran pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la// dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo// zhes brjod/ bu khyed su yin ci la dga'// zhes dris pa la lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag ni skal pa bzang po ste// bde ba che la bdag dga' 'o// zhes brjod/ de yis khyod la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ dbang chen mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i khro chung me mtshon 'bar ba'i tshogs kyis bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par mos shig / rtsa sngags dang sumbha ni drag tu brjod la/ yungs thun dang gu gul dud pa rol mo'i tsham rngam bya/ rdo rje gnas gsum du bzhag ste/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam: dkyil 'khor gsang ba bla med 'di: khyod kyis su la'ang smra ma byed: gal te smras na dam tshig nyams: badzra sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: las kyi rdo rjes drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi mdun khyams su bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥ yol ba bsal/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas nang du 'khod de sgo srung la gsol ba btab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal chen rta mgrin nag po yi: sku gsum gsang ba'i sgo srung ba: shar lho nub byang sgo srung bzhis: pho brang phyogs bzhi'i sgo phyes la: bdag cag dkyil 'khor lha dang sprod: ces gsol ba btab pas/ pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ ces dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes pa la phyogs bzhi re re bzhin phyag 'tshal bar mos pas thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐: na mā mi hūm̐: na mo na maḥhūm̐: lan bzhi/ de dag gis phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa grub nas/

dbang gi dngos gzhir gyur pa nang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la khyed rang sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun la dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin du gsal thob cig / las chu 'thor la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su bdud bzhi chung mar bcas dang klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong padma nyi zla'i gdan la/ khyed rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig mthing nag 'od du 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ klu dang sde brgyad gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod pa las khyed rang rta mgrin nag po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum sdang mig tu bsgrad cing khrag ltar g.yo ba: zhas gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba: rno dbal ngar dang ldan pa'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba: phyag g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i ral gri me 'bar bas dgra bgegs kyi mgo lus dum bur gtubs pa: g.yon pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pas dgra bgegs kyi dbang po sdom zhing snying nas 'dren pa: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa: sku stong glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba: sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba: de'i steng du dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba: thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa: sbrul rigs lngas sku la brgyan pa: gdol pa nag pos do shal la mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa: lcags kyi ral pa spyi bor bcings shing sku rgyab tu 'phyang pa rting rtser bslebs pa: ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb nas sprul pa'i khro chung mang po skar ltar 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs klu gdon gnod byed thams cad thar bar brlag cing 'joms par byed pa:

g.yon gyi sdigs mdzub rtse las sdig pa nag po mgo dgu pa ri rab tsam 'gyed pa las sprul pa'i lcags sdig grangs med thog ltar 'phro ba/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ snying gar rdo rje hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥmathing nag rab tu 'bar ba/ de rnams dang slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor dang rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams nas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rgya mtsho la char babs pa ltar khyed rang la gnyis med du thim par mos shig / spro na las gzhung gi spyan 'dren dbyangs bcas brjod/ spos dang rol mo bcas/ rtsa sngags mthar/ e ā ralli sarba tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza: sa ma ya ā be sha ya a ā: zhes btags pa drag tu brjod la dbab/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas spyi bor bzhag la/ ye shes pa sgo gsum la brtan par gyur cig /tiṣṭha badzra/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid las kyis 'brel ba'i rigs gang yin pa la phog par shog cig snyam pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas te 'dor bar zhu/ dbang chen rta mgrin pho brang du: 'brel ba'i me tog 'di dor bas: sngon nas las 'phro gang 'brel ba'i: yi dam lha dang 'phrad par shog: oṃ puṣpe siddhi gṛhṇa ho: zhes 'dor du gzhug /rigs brtags la/ de dang mthun pa'i ming sbyin pa'am/ yang na spyi khyab tu/ me tog gtso bo la phog par mos pas lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin cing gsang mtshan rdo rje dbang chen drag po rtsal zhes bya bar zungs shig /ma rig pa'i sgrib pa mig dar dang lhan cig bsal bar mos shig /kye: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis: khyed kyi 'khor ba ma rig mig: shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin gyis: ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya'o: oṃ badzra tsakṣuḥpra be sha ya phaṭa: ces mig dar bsal/

ye shes kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob nas dpal rta mgrin nag po'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mjal bar mos la dad spro skyed mdzod/ de dag gis sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub pa lags/ dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul/ thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la: ji ltar mchod chen bstsal pa ltar: bdag kyang mchod pa'i don gyi phyir: nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams kyis dbang gi phrin las mdzad/ rta mgrin rgyal po rigs lngas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa rdo rje bdud rtsis gang bas khyed rang dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyi bo nas gtor blugs kyi cho ga sgrub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rnam bum gyis dbang bskur la/ hūm̐: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsang gsum las byung ba: khams gsum pas ni phyag bgyis phyir: rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ badzra buddha ratna padma karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: dkyil 'khor gyi lha dbang chen rigs lnga'i sku las ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi phung po lnga la thim pas dug lnga'i rtog tshogs lhar gyur par mos shig /

sku tsaka gnas lngar bzhag la/ hrī: ha ya grī ba rta mchog dpal: 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa po: khros pa'i nga ros srid gsum 'dul: dug lnga rnam 'joms dbang 'di longs: badzra buddha ratna padma karma ha ya grī ba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams gnas so sor bgos te mnga' gsol bar mos shig /hrī: dpal gyi chas dang dur khrod rgyan: sna tshogs 'khrul 'khor rnam dag phyir: chags sdang rtog pa thams cad dag: chos rnams yongs rdzogs dbang 'di longs: shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs nas thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥmathar 'khod par mos shig /hrī: ngag la sngags kyis dbang bskur bas: drag pos khams gsum sgrol bar byed: 'brug ltar sgrog pa khro rgyal gsung: gsang sngags snying po'i dbang 'di longs: oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐: sngags byang mgrin par bzhag /rtsa sngags lan gsum/ sham bu ring thung lan re'i rjes zlos dang me tog 'bul ster spyi ltar bya/ spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur gyis mtshan nas rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags pas sa gsum zil gyis non par sgoms shig / rta dbu spyi bor bkod la/ hrī: rta mgos rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i don: gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ldan: rta skad rngam pa'i dbang 'di longs: hrīḥgho ḍa ha ya grī ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: āoṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: dbu rgyan phyag mtshan ming dang chas gos rnams kyis rim par mnga' gsol bas che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i gzi brjid 'bar bar mos shig / dbang rdzas rnams tshig bstun gtad la/ hrī: dbu rgyan rigs lnga ye shes lnga: bde gshegs kun dang mnyam par sbyor: thod sbrul 'bar ba'i gzi 'bar ba: cod pan bzang po khyod kyis longs:

ratna mu kuṭa pa ṭa laṃ hrī: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: shes rab ye shes rdo rje'i mtshon: ral gri 'bar bas nyon mongs 'joms: 'jam dpal rab tu mi bzad pa: rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon 'di longs: badzra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: snying rje chen po shes rab thabs: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam las 'dren: byams chen mtshon cha thabs la mkhas: lcags kyu 'bar ba'i mtshon 'di longs: badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: rdaur dril lhan cig spyi bor bkod la/ kye rdo rje dbang chen drag po rtsal zhes bya ba'o// hrī: rdo rje dril bu rig pa 'dzin: gnyis med ye shes rdo rje che: khams gsum las las rnam grol ba'i: rdo rje'i ming 'di khyod kyis longs: badzra nām a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid che: dar nag kun khyab rdo rje'i chas: dpal chen gos 'chang bdud rnams las: rnam par rgyal phyir rtags su sbyin: kā la wast+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: rnam bum gyis dbang bskur/ bum chu spyi bor 'thor la/ hrī: rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa na: dbang drag lha rnams ma 'dres gsal: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: du ma ro gcig dbang 'di longs: badzra kā ya buddha ratna padma karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas dbu gtsug rta mgo'i steng du 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis mtshan par mos shig / tsakli mgor bzhag la/ hrī: rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas ni: sku mdog dmar gsal chags bral don gyi lha: bdud las rnam rgyal rigs pa'i gsung dbyangs ldan: mi gnas ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra a mi dhe wa ud bha be a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: sngar phul ba'i me tog gtso bo'i phyag gis bzhes te slar dbang rtags cod pan gyi tshul du spyi bor bcings par mos shig / cod pan spyi bor bzhag la/ hrī: cod pan mi 'gyur mandā ra: sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba: dbyings dang rig pa gnyis med pa'i: rtags kyi me tog 'di yang longs: oṃ badzra su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swā hā: me tog 'thor zhing spos btul/ rol mo bsgrag / des bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye: sangs rgyas kun bdag rig pa 'dzin: dpa' bo padma he ru ka: gsang ba mchog gi ye shes de: slob dpon chen pos bdag la stsol: lan gsum/ thod pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba khyed rang gi spyi bo dang mgrin pa nas zhugs/ rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig / bandha thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi che: byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du gsal: rtsa khams bde ba'i rang bzhin las: thabs shes zung 'jug dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod la spyi bor bzhag /lag tu gtad la 'thung gzhug / des gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rtsa rlung sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos/ hrī: bde chen rol pa dbang gi rgyal: khrag 'thung yaksha he ru ka: bde ba'i ye shes rnyed dka' ba: bdag la yang dag bskyed du gsol: lan gsum/ khyed rang gi lus kyi nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga a haṃ thig le dang bcas par gsal ba la sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo 'od dmar khyug ge byung*/

lte ba'i a shad bskul/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams khyab/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig g.yos pas yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar mos la rlung kha sbyor du 'ching bar zhu/ me long snying gar bzhag cing thig le byas la/ hrī: chos nyid bde ba chen po la: rtsal dang rol pa ngang gis shar: rang byung ye shes bde chen gyi: rang bzhin dag dang mnyam par sbyor: a ho ma hā su kha ho: des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam thig le sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o// de ltar yas babs kyi dga' bzhi mthar thug pa thig le nor bu'i rtse mor son pa rlung gis 'dzag med du 'ching ba dang*/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas gyen du drangs pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i mthar thug thig le rta dbu'i rtser son cing brtan pas 'pho med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos la de'i rang ngor lhug par 'jog 'tshal/ hrī: chos nyid skye med nam mkha'i dngos: nam mkha' bde chen rol pas khyab: skye dang 'jig pa'i mtha' las 'das: dam tshig chen po'i dbang 'di longs: dzñā na pañtsa a a a: blo 'das ka dag gi dgongs pa ma bcos rang byung gi gnas lugs bzhi cha gsum bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes cung zad bskyang du bcug / des dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o// mtha' rten yongs rdzogs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ gtor snod dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen por gtor ma dpal chen rta mgrin nag po gtso 'khor bcu gsum dngos su bzhugs pa'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud bla ma/ bar du yi dam zhi khro/ 'og tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa khyed rang gi spyi bor spyan drangs pas/

de dag gi sku gsung thugs las byin rlabs ye shes 'od zer khro chung me mtshon thig le'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi gnas lngar thim pas sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal/ mthu stobs yon tan ma lus pa rgyas/ dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stan thog gcig tu thob par mos shig / dpal gtor gnas lngar bzhag la/ hrī: sku yi dbang bskur che btsan lhun rdzogs shing: gsung gi dbang bskur ngag gi nus par ldan: thugs kyi dbang bskur ye shes gsal dag rtogs: yon tan dbang bskur sa dang lam la gnas: phrin las dbang bskur 'gro don thams cad 'grub: thams cad yongs rdzogs dpal chen gtor ma'i dbang: yongs la mnga' bsgyur bdag nyid chen por shog: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur ni/ kā ya wā ka tsitta gu ṇa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: āoṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: spro na brgyud pa'i mtshan brjod la bka' bsgo spyi ltar bya/ shis brjod gang 'os bya zhing me tog 'thor la rol mor bsgrag / des yongs rdzogs gtor ma'i dbang thob pas dpal chen rta mgrin nag po dang dbyer med pa'i mthu rtsal nus pa yongs su rdzogs shing rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ma lus pa 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no// des sprul pa'i gter chen zhig po gling pa'i zab gter las byon pa rta mgrin nag po yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs mtha' rten bcas thob pa yin pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇḍal sogs spyi ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor rjes rim gter gzhung ltar gtor ma byin rlabs nas gtor 'bul bstod pa phrin bcol bcas pa dang*/ gter srung la'ang gtor ma phul/ 'grub na gtum drag me 'khor lta bu rigs mthun nas blangs te tshogs 'khor skor ba sogs kyang bya/ gang ltar mchod bstod nongs bshags/ mdun bskyed yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na snang ba lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal te rang la bsdu zhing de las sa bon nā da 'od gsal du bsdus te slar gnyug ma'i lhar ldangs nas bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan no// gnas skabs gdug can 'byung po'i tsha ngar bcom// mthar thug padma gsung mchog bde blag tu// 'grub pa'i lam 'di legs byas dbyar skyes la// sprin gyi myu gu'i rgyun bzhin 'phel rgyas shog
/ces zab chos 'di nyid kyi zhabs tog dang bka'i bsdu bar dmigs te rin chen gter gyi mdzod chen por bzhugs su gsol ba'i tshe padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //
